title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 2300 Sylvan Avenue in Modesto, California, as the "Corporal Michael D. Anderson Jr. Post Office Building".
official_summary: This act designates the facility of the U.S. Postal Service located at 2300 Sylvan Avenue in Modesto, California, as the Corporal Michael D. Anderson Jr. Post Office Building.

summary.headline: Names a Modesto, California post office building after Corporal Michael D. Anderson Jr.
summary.what_it_does: This law officially renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2300 Sylvan Avenue in Modesto, California. The building will be known as the Corporal Michael D. Anderson Jr. Post Office Building. It does not change how the post office operates or its services.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 2, 2025, and the naming took effect on that date.
